name: weapons-items
description: The five weapon items in the game are the proposed ones (D-076): Iron Musket (Forge level 2, never stacks), Explosive Arrow (Forge level 4, 10 per craft, stacks of 50), Dynamite (Forge level 2, 5 per craft, stacks of 20), the Asksvin Harness (Workbench level 2, never stacks) and the Mobile Cannon build piece in the KY-Items category beside a Forge; all of them are listed in KydlCore's KY-Items registry

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 1, enabled True: Iron x15, Wood x10, Bronze x2
steps.label: the musket recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 4, makes 10, enabled True: Wood x8, BlackMetal x1, Feathers x2, GP_Gunpowder x2
steps.label: the explosive arrow recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: forge level 2, makes 5, enabled True: Iron x2, GP_Gunpowder x5, Resin x1
steps.label: the dynamite recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.recipeOf
steps.expect: piece_workbench level 2, makes 1, enabled True: LeatherScraps x10, Chain x3, Bronze x2
steps.label: the harness recipe in the game

steps.name: GunPowdered.pieceOf
steps.expect: category KY-Items, station forge, enabled True: FlametalNew x20, Blackwood x30, Iron x10, in KY-Items True
steps.label: the mobile cannon is in the KY-Items build category and listed in KY-Items

steps.name: GunPowdered.kyItemsListed
steps.label: every item and piece of the mod is in the KY-Items list
